description: Book a FedEx parcel option from parcel_quote. Requires the quote_id the user chose and the full delivery address with contact name and phone; pickup can be omitted only when a default shipper is saved. ZIPs must match the quote. The packages are the ones quoted (not resent). Charges the account like book does (terms accounts are billed on terms; others pay from the Warp balance, with the saved card covering any shortfall). Only call after the user explicitly confirms this option and price. Auth required.

delivery.description: Delivery address and contact, every required field

phone.description: Contact phone. FedEx requires it on both stops: ask the user if you don't have it.

zipCode.description: 5-digit ZIP; must match the quoted ZIP

delivery_window.description: Local delivery window, 24h HH:MM. Defaults to 08:00-20:00.

pickup.description: Pickup address. Required if no default shipper is saved.

phone.description: Contact phone. FedEx requires it on both stops: ask the user if you don't have it.

zipCode.description: 5-digit ZIP; must match the quoted ZIP

pickup_window.description: Local pickup window, 24h HH:MM. Defaults to 08:00-20:00.

quote_id.description: quote_id of the option the user chose, from your MOST RECENT parcel_quote
